openQuestions.question: inlineBootScript deviates from 'module none': TypeScript 6.0.3 deprecates module=None and its output for export {} is Object.defineProperty(exports, ...), which throws in a classic script. The plugin transpiles with module ESNext (target ES2017, removeComments) and an after-transformer that drops export {} and export modifiers and throws on any import. The stub transpiles to an empty <script></script>, and WP-10 can export pure functions from boot.ts for boot.test.ts.
openQuestions.default: ESNext plus the strip transformer, documented in vite.config.ts; transpileBootScript is exported for postbuild or tests.
